module_summary: PCPI coprocessor for RISC-V DIV/DIVU/REM/REMU: decodes the instruction, then runs a 32-iteration restoring shift-subtract divider on sign-corrected operands with sign fix-up on completion.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Coprocessor request valid gating instruction decode

anchors.name: pcpi_rs1
anchors.why: Dividend operand loaded, sign-corrected, into dividend register

anchors.name: pcpi_rs2
anchors.why: Divisor operand loaded, sign-corrected and shifted, into divisor

anchors.name: pcpi_rd
anchors.why: Result: signed quotient or remainder written back

anchors.name: pcpi_ready
anchors.why: One-cycle completion pulse when division finishes

anchors.name: pcpi_wr
anchors.why: Register writeback enable asserted with result

anchors.name: pcpi_wait
anchors.why: Tells core a div/rem instruction is being processed

anchors.name: instr_div
anchors.why: Decoded op flag selecting signed handling and quotient output

anchors.name: start
anchors.why: Rising edge of wait; loads operands and starts iteration

anchors.name: running
anchors.why: Two-state busy controller for the iterative divider

anchors.name: quotient_msk
anchors.why: One-hot bit position shifting right; zero ends iteration

anchors.name: dividend
anchors.why: Partial remainder, reduced by divisor each step

anchors.name: divisor
anchors.why: Shifted divisor compared and subtracted each iteration

anchors.name: quotient
anchors.why: Quotient accumulated by OR-ing mask bits

anchors.name: outsign
anchors.why: Result sign latched at start, negates output

anchors.name: pcpi_wait_q
anchors.why: Delayed wait used for start edge detection

groups.name: Instruction decoder
groups.description: Decodes DIV/REM variants and generates wait and start

groups.name: Divider control
groups.description: Busy state and iteration mask sequencing completion

groups.name: PCPI request
groups.description: Request valid and source operands from core
